notes: Voice assistant actions shared by iOS and Android. The live session declares these tools plus the existing Coach data tools (get_data_summary ... search_exercise_library). Every tool here must have a handler on both platforms; an action a platform cannot do returns {"ok": false, "error": "unsupported"}. See README.md for effects, confirmation and result conventions.

tools.name: get_app_state
tools.description: What the app is showing right now: current screen, the Home diary date, whether the camera is open (and in which mode), today's calorie and macro totals against goals, unit system, and what this session can do (camera_frames: continuous, per_turn, or none). Call this when you need context before acting.

tools.name: open_screen
tools.description: Show a screen of the app so the user can see it. Use settings_section to open a specific part of Settings.

tools.name: set_diary_date
tools.description: Switch the Home diary to a day (and show Home).

tools.name: open_food_entry
tools.description: Open a logged food entry's detail/edit view so the user can see it. entry_id comes from get_food_entries or log_food.

tools.name: open_camera
tools.description: Open the camera inside the assistant. mode=food shows a live preview (you see frames if camera_frames is not none); ask the user to show their food, then call capture_photo. mode=barcode is opened by scan_barcode instead.

tools.name: capture_photo
tools.description: Take one photo with the open camera, close its preview, then analyze the food with the app's normal food scan. Reopen the camera only for another camera task. The voice conversation continues. Returns a draft (draft_id, items, totals) shown to the user as a card; nothing is logged until log_food. With auto-capture on you may call this as soon as the food is clearly in frame; otherwise wait until the user says to take it.

note.description: Optional context the user gave, e.g. 'half portion' or 'cooked in olive oil'.

tools.name: close_camera
tools.description: Close the assistant's camera.

tools.name: pick_photos
tools.description: Open the photo library to choose photos of one meal, then analyze them. The food-analysis mode allows up to 3 photos with hosted AI or 4 with the user's own API key. Waits for the user; returns a draft, or cancelled.

tools.name: scan_barcode
tools.description: Open the barcode scanner, wait for a product barcode, and look it up. Returns a draft, not_found, or cancelled. Ask the user to point the camera at the barcode.

tools.name: describe_food
tools.description: Estimate nutrition for food the user described in words (e.g. 'two eggs and a slice of toast'). Returns a draft; nothing is logged until log_food.

tools.name: search_foods
tools.description: Search the user's saved meals, favorites and recently logged foods by name. Returns saved_food_id values for log_food.

tools.name: log_food
tools.description: Log food to the diary from exactly one source: a draft_id (from capture_photo, pick_photos, scan_barcode or describe_food), a saved_food_id (from search_foods), or a manual item. Applying the save closes an open food camera without ending the conversation. Returns the new entry_ids.

date.description: yyyy-MM-dd; default is the diary date shown on Home.

user_confirmed.description: True only after the user agreed to this exact change.

tools.name: update_food_entry
tools.description: Change a logged food entry. Only the fields given change.

tools.name: delete_food_entry
tools.description: Delete a logged food entry. Always ask the user first.

tools.name: log_water
tools.description: Log water. Give amount with unit (ml, l, oz, cup = 240 ml, glass = 250 ml).

date.description: yyyy-MM-dd; default the Home diary date.

tools.name: start_fast
tools.description: Start a fast now with a goal length in hours (e.g. 16).

tools.name: end_fast
tools.description: End the fast that is running now.

tools.name: log_weight
tools.description: Log a body weight reading.

tools.name: log_body_fat
tools.description: Log a body-fat percentage reading.

tools.name: describe_workout
tools.description: Turn a spoken workout description (e.g. 'bench 3 sets of 8 at 60 kg, then 20 minutes running') into a workout draft with the app's workout text parser. Returns a draft; nothing is saved until log_workout.

date.description: yyyy-MM-dd; default the workout diary's selected day.

tools.name: log_workout
tools.description: Save a workout draft from describe_workout to the workout diary.

tools.name: log_cardio
tools.description: Log a quick cardio activity by duration.

calories.description: Optional; estimated by the app if omitted.

tools.name: get_settings
tools.description: Current values of the settings update_setting can change.

tools.name: update_setting
tools.description: Change one setting. Keys: theme_color (fudPink, red, orange, green, mint, teal, blue, purple, yellow, coral, roseGold, mochaBrown, indigo, lavender), appearance (system, light, dark), units (metric, imperial), calorie_goal (kcal), protein_goal_g, carbs_goal_g, fat_goal_g, water_goal_ml, assistant_voice (a voice id of the current provider), assistant_auto_capture (true/false), assistant_confirm_saves (true/false). A key a platform lacks returns unsupported.

value.description: The new value as text, e.g. 'dark', '2200', 'true'.

tools.name: end_conversation
tools.description: Close the assistant when the user says goodbye or asks you to stop. Say a short goodbye first.
